The '''O'reen Star Corps''' was a group of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who patrolled the [[O'reen system/Legends|O'reen system]] and protected it from outside threats. The Star Corps prevented anyone from approaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] without the proper [[clearance code]]s. Members of Star Corps also raided neary [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to steal high-tech weapons for the [[O'reenian]]s.<ref name="AFC ">{{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=A Fool's Charge}}</ref>
